title: Occupancy Pricing on Relocks of the Builder Extended Rate Lock
content:
The relock fee on a Builder Extended Rate Lock reflects how the buyer intends to occupy the home, as recorded when the homesite was reserved.

**Rule.** Where the occupancy intent on the Homesite Reservation that converted into the lock's purchase agreement is investor, 0.125 percentage points are added to the relock fee percent; where it is second home, 0.0625 percentage points are added; any other occupancy adds nothing. The points are added to the relock fee percent before that percent is applied to the loan amount on the lock.

| Occupancy intent on the converted Homesite Reservation | Added to the relock fee percent |
|---|---|
| investor | 0.125 percentage points |
| second home | 0.0625 percentage points |
| any other occupancy | nothing |

## Basis questions

**Which record is read?** The Homesite Reservation that converted into the purchase agreement the lock finances; the purchase agreement record carries the link to that reservation, and the occupancy intent is read from the reservation.

**The buyer now says the home will be a primary residence, but the converted reservation shows second home. What applies?** The occupancy intent on the converted Homesite Reservation decides the adjustment: 0.0625 percentage points.

**Hypothetical effect.** A relock fee percent of 0.250 on a lock whose converted reservation shows investor becomes 0.375 before it is applied to the loan amount.
